Вивчимо фрази, щоб почати, підтримати й:
Learn phrases to start, keep up and end a conversation with a colleague
Listen to two colleagues talking in the office kitchen
Practise Past Simple and Present Perfect questions for small talk
Role-play a conversation with a new colleague
Почніть з 2 питань у парах (2 хв), потім: Start with 2 questions in pairs (2 min), then a quick sorting task (2-3 min). Don’t correct mistakes during the conversation, just note 2-3 typical ones and come back to them at the Language focus stage. Ask whether “risky” topics are the same in different countries.
Є плани на свята?: Do you have any holiday plans?
It was nice talking to you.
поспілкуватися, наздогнати новини: to talk and share news after some time apart
розрядити атмосферу, почати розмову: to make people feel relaxed and start a conversation
безпечна тема: a topic that is easy and won’t upset anyone
підтримувати розмову: to stop a conversation from ending too soon
до речі: used to add something new to the conversation
Прочитайте фрази вголос з природною інто: Read the phrases aloud with natural intonation (How’s it GOing?). Students repeat in chorus or one by one. Exercises 5-6 min, check together. If a student answers with one word, ask them to “add a detail and ask the question back”.
Перше прослуховування на загальне розумі: First listening for general understanding (gist), second for details. After checking, ask students to find 3 ways to ask the question back in the dialogue (How about you? / Have you ever…? / What did you cook?) and 1 way to end the conversation. 12-15 min in total.
Відповідай не одним словом, а коротким р: Don’t answer with one word: use a short sentence and ask the question back: **Not bad, thanks. I went hiking. How about you?** Ask about last weekend in the Past Simple: **Did you have…? / What did you do? / How was…?** Ask about life experience in the Present Perfect: **Have you ever been to…?**
Приємно було поговорити: It was nice talking to you
Нагадайте різницю: конкретний час у мину: Remind students of the difference: a specific time in the past (weekend, Saturday) = Past Simple; experience with no time = Present Perfect. A typical mistake: “How was your weekend? - Was good.” Correct it right away: It was good. Exercises 6-7 min, check aloud.
Рольова гра в парах 2-3 хв на роль, поті: Role-play in pairs, 2-3 min per role, then swap. In a one-to-one lesson the teacher plays role B. Listen for whether the student asks questions back and ends the conversation politely. After the role-play, give 2 strong phrases and 2 corrections. Voice can be set as homework if time is short.
Учні пишуть 5 хв, 1-2 читають уголос. До: Students write for 5 min, 1-2 read aloud. Homework: record the voice answer (if you didn’t manage to), and on the next working day try small talk with a colleague and bring 1 phrase that worked.
Обговоримо, як ми реагуємо на стрес\nПод:
Discuss how we react to stress
Watch a TED talk and check understanding
Learn vocabulary about emotions and health, verbs with prepositions
Debate and give opinions, agreeing and disagreeing
Короткий старт: 2 питання усно, потім шк: Quick start: 2 questions orally, then an opinion scale (not graded). Ask the student to explain one answer on the scale. Don’t dig into personal stories if the student doesn’t want to: the topic is sensitive, so let them answer in general terms.
справлятися з: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
звертатися по підтримку: to ask someone for help or support
стійкість: the ability to recover quickly from difficulties
сприймати: to notice or understand something in a particular way
бути під тиском: to feel stressed because a lot is expected of you
вигоріти: to become exhausted from working too hard
спосіб упоратися (зі стресом): a way of dealing with stress or problems
негативно позначатися на: to have a bad effect on something over time
перевантажений, пригнічений: feeling that there is too much to deal with
Пройдіться по словах, звертаючи увагу на: Go through the words, paying attention to the pronunciation of resilience /rɪˈzɪliəns/ and perceive. Exercises 5-6 min. Ask the student to make one sentence of their own with to take a toll on and to burn out.
Подивись talk (14 хв, можна з субтитрами: Watch the talk (14 min, subtitles are fine). What is the speaker’s main idea?
Якщо часу мало, подивіться перші 6-7 хви: If time is short, watch the first 6-7 minutes: that’s where the main study and the key idea are. The rest can be homework. Gist questions first, then details. Discuss whether students agree with the idea, but briefly: the discussion comes at the Speaking stage.
Погоджуємося: **I couldn’t agree more. /: Agreeing: **I couldn’t agree more. / That’s exactly what I think. / Good point.** Disagreeing politely: **I’m not so sure about that. / I see what you mean, but… / That’s not always true.** Verbs with prepositions: **cope with, reach out to, suffer from, worry about, take a toll on**.
Я не впевнений щодо цього: I’m not so sure about that
Як ти справляєшся зі стресом?: How do you cope with stress?
Прослухайте короткий діалог і попросіть: Play the short dialogue and ask students to find phrases for agreeing and disagreeing. Then exercises 6-7 min. Typical mistakes: “cope the stress” without with, and “worry for”. Correct right away and ask the student to repeat the whole sentence.
Рольова гра 6 хв (обидві ролі), дискусія: Role-play 6 min (both roles), discussion 5-6 min. Require at least 2 phrases for agreeing/disagreeing. Note mistakes with prepositions and go over them at the end of the stage (1 min).
На уроці учень складає план (теза, 2 арг: In class the student makes a plan (thesis, 2 arguments, conclusion) and writes the introduction, then finishes the rest at home. Homework: finish the post and watch the talk to the end, writing down 3 new expressions.
Вивчимо фрази для замовлення в кафе\nПос:
Learn phrases for ordering in a café
Listen to a café dialogue and work out what the waiter says and what the customer says
Practise Can I have / Could I have / I’d like and some / any
Act out a dialogue
Легкий старт, 3-4 хв. Якщо учень відпові: Easy start, 3-4 min. If the student names a dish in their own language, help with the English word and write it on the board. Don’t correct grammar at this stage.
меню: a list of food and drinks in a café or restaurant
замовляти: to ask for food or drinks in a café
рахунок: a piece of paper showing how much you have to pay
вода без газу / з газом: water without bubbles / water with bubbles
їсти на місці: to eat your food in the café
з собою: to take your food with you and eat it somewhere else
чайові: extra money you give a waiter to say thank you
офіціант / офіціантка: a person who brings food in a café or restaurant
платити карткою: to pay with a bank card
чек: a piece of paper that proves you have paid
Покажіть слова, вимовте bill, receipt /r: Show the words and say bill and receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (the p is silent). Exercises 5 min. Ask the student what they would order right now, using 2-3 new words.
Перше прослуховування: лише gist. Друге:: First listening: gist only. Second: True/False. Then sorting the phrases. You can ask the student to read the dialogue in roles with the teacher to practise the intonation of polite requests. 13-15 min in total.
Ввічливо замовляємо: **Can I have…? / Co: Order politely: **Can I have…? / Could I have…? / I’d like…** (Could sounds the most polite). Don’t say “I want” or “Give me”: it sounds rude. **some** in statements and requests (Can I have some water?), **any** in negatives and questions (We don’t have any cake. Do you have any tea?).
Можна мені воду без газу?: Can I have some still water?
Рахунок, будь ласка: Can I have the bill, please?
Explain the rule using examples from the dialogue. Note: in requests and offers (Would you like some…?) we use some, even though it is a question. Exercises 6-7 min. Correct “I want” gently: “That sounds a bit abrupt, try Could I have…”.
Рольова гра 2 рази по 3 хв. Учень-клієнт: Role-play twice, 3 min each. The student playing the customer gets a “problem” (no orange juice) and has to react. Note 2 good phrases and 2 corrections. Voice can be moved to homework.
Учні пишуть 5 хв, потім читають з учител: Students write for 5 min, then read in roles with the teacher. Homework: finish the dialogue, record the voice answer and find the menu of any English-speaking café online, writing down 5 new words.
Послухаємо дискусію двох колег про відда:
Listen to two colleagues discussing remote work
Learn phrases for discussing pros and cons
Practise I’d rather, I’d prefer and prefer… to…
Negotiate a hybrid schedule with a manager and write an email
2 questions orally and a scale (not graded). Ask the student to explain one extreme answer. Time: 4-5 min. Note mistakes but don’t correct them.
їздити на роботу: to travel regularly to and from work
дорога на роботу: the journey to and from work
гнучкий графік: working time that you can change to suit you
відволікатися: to lose focus because of something else
ізольований, самотній: alone and without contact with other people
відключитися (від роботи): to stop thinking about work and relax
баланс роботи й життя: the right amount of time for work and for personal life
гібридний графік: a work plan that mixes office days and home days
недолік: a disadvantage or negative side of something
встановлювати межі: to make clear limits on what you will and won’t do
Розберіть різницю to commute (дієслово): Go over the difference between to commute (verb) and a commute (noun). Exercises 5-6 min. Ask the student to describe their own commute and work-life balance in 2-3 sentences.
Перше прослуховування на gist, друге на: First listening for gist, second for details. Note: it’s Kate, not Daniel, who works until ten at night; this is a typical trap. After checking, ask: “Whose position is closer to yours?” (1-2 min).
Обговорюємо плюси й мінуси: **The main b: Discussing pros and cons: **The main benefit is… / The downside is… / It depends on… / The best of both worlds.** Preference: **I’d rather + verb without to** (I’d rather stay at home), **I’d rather not…**, **I’d rather A than B**. Also **I’d prefer + to + verb** and **I prefer + -ing + to + -ing** (I prefer working at home to commuting).
Головний недолік у тому, що я почуваюся: The main downside is that I feel isolated
Це найкраще з двох світів: It’s the best of both worlds
Типові помилки: «I’d rather to stay» і «: Typical mistakes: “I’d rather to stay” and “I prefer work at home than…”. Correct right away and ask the student to repeat. Exercises 6-7 min, check aloud with explanations.
Рольова гра з переговорами: керівник має: A negotiation role-play: the manager shouldn’t agree right away. Require phrases from Language focus. 7-8 min for the role-play, 3-4 min for questions. Voice can be moved to homework.
На уроці учень пише план і перший абзац: In class the student writes a plan and the first paragraph of the email (5-6 min), the rest at home. Remind them of the structure: purpose, arguments, proposal, polite ending. Homework: finish the email and record the voice answer if not done in class.
Прочитаємо есе про штучний інтелект і тв:
Read an essay about artificial intelligence and creativity
Learn C1 vocabulary for discussions
Practise cautious language (hedging) and counterarguments
Hold a debate and write an argumentative paragraph
Дайте учням 30 секунд подумати перед від: Give students 30 seconds to think before answering. At C1, expect extended answers with examples. Note 1-2 good expressions and 1-2 inaccuracies for feedback later.
оригінальний: new and not copied from anything else
наслідувати: to copy the way someone or something does things
намір: the purpose or plan behind an action
розмивати межу: to make the difference between two things less clear
відкидати, не сприймати всерйоз: to decide something is not important or not worth considering
прорив: an important new discovery or achievement
мабуть, можна стверджувати: it can be argued that; possibly
викликати занепокоєння: to make people worried about something
авторство: the fact of being the creator of a work
вторинний, неоригінальний: copied from other works, not original
Зверніть увагу на колокації: raise conce: Pay attention to collocations: raise concerns, blur the line between X and Y, a genuine breakthrough. Exercises 5-6 min. Ask the student to use arguably and derivative in a sentence about modern film or music.
Перше читання 4-5 хв на загальну ідею (о: First reading, 4-5 min, for the general idea (choose a title). Second reading for details. Ask the student to find 3 examples of hedging in the text (arguably, perhaps, may) to prepare for the next stage. 13-15 min in total.
Hedging, тобто обережні формулювання, зв: Hedging, or cautious language, sounds more convincing in a discussion: **It could be argued that… / To some extent… / This may suggest that… / There seems to be… / I’m not entirely convinced that…** The modals **may / might / could** and the verbs **seem / appear / tend to** soften strong statements.
Можна стверджувати, що ШІ розмиває межу: It could be argued that AI blurs the line between a tool and a creator
До певної міри я з цим згоден: To some extent, I agree with that
Поясніть, що hedging не означає слабкіст: Explain that hedging doesn’t mean a weak position: it is the norm in academic and business English. Exercises 6-7 min. The translation may have other correct versions: accept them manually. Typical mistake: “in some extent” instead of to some extent.
Спершу шкала (1-2 хв), потім дебати за к: First the scale (1-2 min), then a debate using cards. In a one-to-one lesson the teacher takes the position opposite to the student’s real opinion. Listen for hedging and counterarguments, and give feedback on the 2 strongest phrases and 2 inaccuracies.
На уроці учень пише тезу і перший аргуме: In class the student writes the thesis and the first argument (5-6 min), then finishes the paragraph at home. Homework: a paragraph of 150-180 words and 5 sentences with the new vocabulary. Check not only grammar but also the logic of the argument and the variety of hedging.
Вивчимо 12 поширених ідіом про роботу\nП:
Learn 12 common idioms about work
Listen to a work meeting and find the idioms in context
Learn to change the form of idioms in a sentence and use them appropriately
Practise them in conversation and in a work message
Попросіть учня навести українську ідіому: Ask the student to give an idiom about work from their own language and explain it in English. Then 2 guessing questions. Don’t give the right answers straight away: let the student explain the logic.
халтурити, економити на якості: to do something badly or cheaply to save time or money
закінчити на сьогодні: to stop working for the day
однаково розуміти ситуацію: to understand a situation in the same way
мислити нестандартно: to think creatively, in a new way
тепер твій хід: it’s your turn to act or decide
почати, запустити процес: to start a process or activity
робити свою частину роботи: to do your fair share of the work
почати все спочатку: to start again because the plan failed
швидке і складне навчання: something that is hard and fast to learn
зробити більше, ніж треба: to do more than is expected
бути завваленим роботою: to have too much work to deal with
коротко зв’язатися, звіритися: to make brief contact with someone to check in
Розберіть ідіоми, звертаючи увагу на обр: Go through the idioms, paying attention to the image behind them (drawing board = a board for drawing plans, snowed under = buried in snow). Exercises 5-6 min. Ask the student to describe a colleague (no names) using 2 idioms.
Перше прослуховування: про що нарада. Др: First listening: what the meeting is about. Second: details. Then ask the student to write down all the idioms they heard (there are 12) and explain 3 of them in their own words. 13-15 min.
Ідіоми живуть у реченні: дієслово змінює: Idioms live in sentences: the verb changes for tense and person (**He never pulls his weight. / We cut corners last time. / I’ve been snowed under.**), and the pronoun changes with context (**the ball is in your / their court**). Don’t overload your speech with idioms: one or two per conversation sound natural, five in a row sound like a textbook.
Тепер твій хід: The ball is in your court
Нам доведеться почати все спочатку: We’ll have to go back to the drawing board
Наголосіть, що ідіоми не можна переклада: Stress that idioms can’t be translated word for word and their nouns can’t be changed (not their box, not learning line). Exercises 6-7 min. The translation may have other correct versions: accept them manually.
Рольова гра 6-7 хв, потім питання. Рахуй: Role-play 6-7 min, then questions. Count how many idioms the student used appropriately and note the ones that sounded unnatural. The voice task can be moved to homework.
Учні пишуть 5-6 хв, потім вчитель комент: Students write for 5-6 min, then the teacher comments on how appropriate the idioms and tone are. Homework: finish the message, record a voice story and notice at least 2 idioms from the lesson in a TV series, podcast or work emails.
